description: The Replacement schema of first-order set theory has one axiom for each formula \(\psi(x,y,p_1,\ldots,p_k)\) in which \(B\) is not free: for every set \(A\) and fixed set parameters, if every \(x\in A\) has exactly one output set \(y\) satisfying \(\psi\), there is a set \(B\) such that \(y\in B\) holds exactly when \(\psi(x,y,p_1,\ldots,p_k)\) holds for some \(x\in A\), for every set \(y\).
